label: Participant groups
summary: The list of participant groups (the groups of characters taking part) of a situation.
details: A situation is a long-running, large-area game event such as the Silk Road or the Dynastic Cycle. Going by its name and its use as the list behind the situation participation window (and its debug version), it gives one entry per group. The game documents no return type.

label: Participating characters
summary: The list of characters taking part in a situation.
details: Vanilla only counts it, showing the number of participants in the situation participation window and its debug version. The game documents no return type.

label: Phases
summary: Going by its name, the list of phases (stages) of a situation.
details: Vanilla never names it on a situation itself. The church and Silk Road windows list phases through the situation's type (GetType.GetPhases), a different type and only a hint. The game documents no return type.

label: Severity description
summary: A text describing how severe a situation is.
details: Vanilla shows it as a single text line in the natural disaster window. Its other uses are not shown, so what it says for other situations is not known.

label: Start date
summary: The date on which the situation started.
details: Vanilla writes it out in long form (GetStringLong) for the "Started:" line of situations and in the situation debug window.

label: Sub-region by key
summary: Going by its name, the situation's sub-region (one part of its area) whose key is given.
details: Vanilla never names it as Situation.GetSubRegionByKey, but the Silk Road texts write GetSituation('silk_road_situation').GetSubRegionByKey('region_silk_road_proper_china') and then read its name or variables; that is a strong hint, not proof. It takes one argument, the sub-region's key in quotes. The game documents no return type.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.values: the sub-region's key in quotes, such as 'region_silk_road_proper_china'

label: Sub-regions
summary: The list of the situation's sub-regions, the parts its area is divided into.
details: Vanilla uses it as the list behind the sub-region entries of the situation window, the Silk Road window and the situation debug window. The game documents no return type.

label: Summary
summary: Going by its name, a short summary text for a situation.
details: Vanilla never names it on a situation. RulerObjectiveAdvice.GetSummary is a different type and only a hint.

label: Character's participant group
summary: The participant group that the given character belongs to in this situation.
details: Vanilla passes the player (GetPlayer.Self), checks whether the result is valid (the player may be in no group) and shows the group's name in the participation window. Going by "Top" in the name it gives the group of the situation as a whole rather than of one sub-region; the game does not say. The game documents no return type.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: The character whose group is looked up.

label: Current phase
summary: The phase (stage) the situation is in right now.
details: Vanilla shows its name as the "Current situation phase" line of the situation list, and the HUD checks its type's key (such as 'impact' or 'warning') to decide what to show. Going by "Top" in the name it is the phase of the situation as a whole, not of one sub-region.

label: Next phase type
summary: Going by its name, the type of the phase the situation will move to next.
details: Vanilla never uses it, so this rests on the name alone. The game documents no return type.

label: Participant group by name
summary: The situation's participant group that has the given group name.
details: Vanilla uses it in the Christian church window and its event widget with the key 'christian_clerical_main_power_rulers' to show that group. It takes one argument, the group's key in quotes. The game documents no return type.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.values: the participant group's key in quotes, such as 'christian_clerical_main_power_rulers'

label: Participant group by type
summary: The situation's participant group of the given participant group type.
details: The game's own description says so, but vanilla never uses it, so what exactly the argument is written as is not shown. The game documents no return type.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: The participant group type to look for.

label: Main sub-region
summary: The situation's top sub-region, the one vanilla reads the current and coming era from.
details: The Dynastic Cycle texts read its current phase's name for the current era and its leading coming phase for the future era. Going by the name it is the main or first sub-region; the game does not say which one counts as top.

label: Situation type
summary: The type of the situation.
details: Vanilla reads the type's illustration for the Silk Road window and the situation list, and the type's 'warning' phase type in the natural disaster window.

label: Window name
summary: The name of the interface window that shows this situation.
details: Vanilla's HUD passes it, together with the situation's ID, to ToggleGameViewData, so clicking a situation button opens or closes that situation's own window.

label: Has end date
summary: Whether the situation has an end date.
details: Vanilla only uses it in the situation debug window to show or hide a line. Going by the name, situations without one run until something else ends them.

label: Has several sub-regions
summary: Whether the situation's area is split into more than one sub-region.
details: Vanilla uses it to pick a different header text for the participant window and to show sub-region parts of the situation window only when there are several.

label: Is participant
summary: Going by its name, whether the given character takes part in the situation.
details: Vanilla never names it on a situation. Activity.IsParticipant( Character.Self ) is a different type and only a hint of how the argument is written.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: The character to check, going by the name.

label: Is valid
summary: Whether this really points to a situation, rather than to nothing.
details: Vanilla uses it in the cardinals window to show a part only when the situation exists.

label: As script scope
summary: The situation turned into a script scope, so texts can read its variables and script values.
details: Vanilla's church texts use it to read the time left on the 'investiture_council_countdown' variable and the 'pam_great_schism_progress_value' script value.

label: Situation itself
summary: The situation itself, used to pass it on to another function.
details: Vanilla passes it, for example, to County.GetSubRegionInSituation and County.GetCurrentPhaseType in the migration window. The game documents no return type.

label: Full catalyst history
summary: Going by its name, whether the situation keeps a full history of its catalysts (the happenings that push its phases).
details: Vanilla never uses it, so this rests on the name alone.

label: Uses migration
summary: Going by its name, whether the situation uses the migration mechanics.
details: Vanilla never uses it, so this rests on the name alone.

label: Access entry itself
summary: A function on a catalyst entry that, going by its name, hands back the entry itself.
details: A catalyst entry is one line in a situation window's list of catalysts (happenings that push phase progress). Vanilla never names this on the type; PdxGuiWidget.AccessSelf is a different type and only a hint. The game documents no return type.

label: Catalyst
summary: The catalyst that this catalyst entry stands for.
details: Vanilla's church window passes it to SituationPhase.GetNumCompletionsOfCatalystForPhase to show how often that catalyst has already happened in a phase. The game documents no return type.

label: Catalyst description
summary: The description text of the catalyst in this entry.
details: Vanilla shows it in the catalyst lists of the church, Silk Road and situation windows.

label: Catalyst points
summary: How many points the catalyst in this entry is worth, a whole number.
details: Vanilla shows it with its sign (plus or minus) in the church and Silk Road windows, so the number can be negative.

label: Entry itself
summary: A function on a catalyst entry that, going by its name, hands back the entry itself.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type. Self appears often after other types (Character.Self passed as an argument); those lines are only a hint. The game documents no return type.

label: Access record itself
summary: A function on a catalyst history record that, going by its name, hands back the record itself.
details: A catalyst history record notes one catalyst that happened in a situation. Vanilla never names this on the type; PdxGuiWidget.AccessSelf is a different type and only a hint. The game documents no return type.

label: Actor
summary: Going by its name, the character who caused the catalyst in this history record.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type. Artifact history entries have their own GetActor (the creator or taker of an artifact); that is only a hint. The game documents no return type.

label: Catalyst type
summary: The type of the catalyst that this history record notes.
details: Vanilla shows the type's name in the Silk Road window and in a shared tooltip.

label: Date
summary: Going by its name, the date on which the catalyst in this history record happened.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type. Other types' GetDate (save games, house unity changes) are written out with GetString; that is only a hint. The game documents no return type.

label: Phase
summary: The situation phase in which the catalyst of this history record happened.
details: Vanilla uses it as the context for history entries in the church and Dynastic Cycle windows. The game documents no return type.

label: Catalyst value
summary: The points value recorded for the catalyst in this history record, a whole number.
details: Vanilla shows it with its sign (plus or minus) in the history lists of the church, Silk Road and Dynastic Cycle windows.

label: Record itself
summary: A function on a catalyst history record that, going by its name, hands back the record itself.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type; Self after other types (Character.Self) is only a hint. The game documents no return type.

label: Access type itself
summary: A function on a catalyst type that, going by its name, hands back the type itself.
details: A catalyst type is the definition of a happening that pushes a situation's phases. Vanilla never names this on the type; PdxGuiWidget.AccessSelf is a different type and only a hint.

label: Catalyst name
summary: Going by its name, the display name of a catalyst type.
details: Vanilla never writes it as SituationCatalystType.GetName, but it reads GetCatalystType.GetName on catalyst history records, which most likely ends here. GetName on other types (traits, activity types) is only a hint.

label: Name without tooltip
summary: The display name of a situation catalyst type as plain text, without the tooltip names usually carry.
details: Vanilla's situation trigger texts use it: "... situation is (not) affected by the [catalyst]".

label: Is valid
summary: Going by its name, whether this really points to a catalyst type rather than to nothing.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type; IsValid after other types (governments) is only a hint.

label: Type itself
summary: A function on a catalyst type that, going by its name, hands back the type itself.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type; Self after other types is only a hint. The game documents no return type.

label: Participant list
summary: The list of participating characters shown in the Christian church window.
details: The Christian church window shows the church situation (councils, schism). Vanilla uses this as the context for the participant list parts of that window.

label: Access window itself
summary: A function on the Christian church window that, going by its name, hands back the window itself.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type; PdxGuiWidget.AccessSelf is a different type and only a hint.

label: Can page back
summary: Whether the phase book in the Christian church window can be turned one page to the left.
details: Vanilla uses it to enable and show the left page button and to pick that button's tooltip.

label: Can page forward
summary: Whether the phase book in the Christian church window can be turned one page to the right.
details: Vanilla uses it to enable and show the right page button and to pick that button's tooltip.

label: Clear selected future phase
summary: Going by its name, clears the coming phase the player has picked in the Christian church window.
details: Vanilla never names it on this window; the Dynastic Cycle window calls SituationWindow.ClearSelectedFuturePhaseType when it opens and on a click, which is only a hint. It returns nothing.

label: Close window
summary: Closes the Christian church window.
details: Vanilla runs it from the window's close button. It returns nothing.

label: Catalyst sub-window
summary: Going by its name, the catalyst part of the Christian church window.
details: Vanilla uses it twice as the context of a part of the church window; what it holds is not shown in the input. The game documents no return type.

label: Catalysts of selected phase
summary: Going by its name, the list of catalysts that apply to the phase picked in the Christian church window.
details: Vanilla never names it on this window. The situation window's own GetCatalystsForSelectedPhase fills a list and is checked for being empty; that is only a hint.

label: Current history page
summary: The entries on the history page now open in the Christian church window.
details: Vanilla fills the history list from it and shows a placeholder when it is empty. The game documents no return type.

label: Ending decisions
summary: Going by its name, the decisions that can end the church situation, as offered in this window.
details: Vanilla never names it on this window. StruggleWindow.GetEndingDecisions counts the decisions that end a struggle; that is only a hint.

label: Left future phase
summary: The coming phase shown on the left page of the Christian church window's phase book.
details: Vanilla uses it as the context of one part of the window.

label: Right future phase
summary: The coming phase shown on the right page of the Christian church window's phase book.
details: Vanilla uses it as the context of one part of the window.

label: History page count
summary: How many pages the history in the Christian church window has.
details: Vanilla shows it as the second number of the "page / pages" counter.

label: History page number
summary: The number of the history page now open in the Christian church window, counted from 1.
details: Vanilla shows it as the first number of the "page / pages" counter and enables the back button only when it is above 1.

label: Participation header
summary: Going by its name, the header text of the participation part of the Christian church window.
details: Vanilla never names it on this window. SituationWindow.GetParticipationWindowHeader gives that heading in the situation and natural disaster windows; that is only a hint.

label: Phase book tooltip
summary: The tooltip of a page button of the Christian church window's phase book.
details: Vanilla passes whether the book can be turned that way (CanTurnPhaseBookLeft or CanTurnPhaseBookRight), so the text depends on whether the button works.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: Whether the book can be turned in that direction.
fields.values: yes or no, from CanTurnPhaseBookLeft or CanTurnPhaseBookRight

label: Phase progress bar
summary: Going by its name, the phase progress bar of a sub-region in the Christian church window.
details: Vanilla never names it on this window. The Silk Road and situation windows call their own GetPhaseProgressComplexBar with SituationSubRegion.Self; that is only a hint of the argument.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: Going by other windows, the sub-region whose progress is shown.

label: Selected future phase
summary: Going by its name, the coming phase picked in the Christian church window.
details: Vanilla never names it on this window; the Dynastic Cycle window's own version is only a hint.

label: Selected future phase type
summary: Going by its name, the type of the coming phase picked in the Christian church window.
details: Vanilla never names it on this window. SituationWindow's version is checked for validity (nothing may be picked) and compared to phase buttons; that is only a hint.

label: Selected or current phase
summary: Going by its name, the picked phase type in the Christian church window, or the current one when nothing is picked.
details: Vanilla never names it on this window; SituationWindow's version in the Dynastic Cycle window is only a hint.

label: Selected or leading phase
summary: Going by its name, the picked coming phase type in the Christian church window, or the one now in the lead when nothing is picked.
details: Vanilla never names it on this window; SituationWindow's version (icon, modifiers) is only a hint.

label: Selected group type
summary: The type of the participant group picked in the Christian church window.
details: Vanilla uses it as the context of the parts that show the picked group. It is set with SetSelectedParticipantGroupType.

label: Selected sub-region
summary: Going by its name, the sub-region picked in the Christian church window.
details: Vanilla never names it on this window; SilkRoadWindow.GetSelectedSubRegion is only a hint.

label: Situation
summary: The situation the Christian church window shows.
details: Vanilla uses it as the context of the window and reads, for example, the player's participant group from it.

label: Situation decisions
summary: The list of decisions tied to the church situation, as listed in the Christian church window.
details: Vanilla fills a list in the window from it; clicking one runs OnDecisionClick. The game documents no return type.

label: Top group participants
summary: The leading participants of the given participant group, as listed in the Christian church window.
details: Vanilla passes the group (SituationParticipantGroup.Self), fills a list from it and shows a placeholder when it is empty. What makes a participant "top" is not documented.

label: Has next history page
summary: Whether the history in the Christian church window has a page after the one now open.
details: Vanilla enables the forward button with it.

label: Has ending decision
summary: Going by its name, whether a decision that can end the church situation is available.
details: Vanilla never names it on this window. Struggle.HasPossibleEndingDecision shows struggle ending buttons; that is only a hint.

label: Has situation decision
summary: Going by its name, whether any decision tied to the church situation is available.
details: Vanilla never uses it, so this rests on the name alone.

label: Left page valid
summary: Whether the left page of the Christian church window's phase book has something to show.
details: Vanilla shows that page only when this holds and a scripted GUI does not mark the chapter as unavailable.

label: Is participant
summary: Going by its name, whether someone takes part in the church situation; who is checked is not documented.
details: Vanilla never names it on this window. Activity.IsParticipant is a different type and only a hint.

label: Right page valid
summary: Whether the right page of the Christian church window's phase book has something to show.
details: Vanilla shows that page when this holds and shows something else in its place when it does not, unless a scripted GUI marks the chapter as unavailable.

label: Next history page
summary: Turns the history in the Christian church window to the next page.
details: Vanilla runs it from the forward button. It returns nothing.

label: Click decision
summary: Runs what happens when the player clicks a decision in the Christian church window.
details: Vanilla passes the clicked decision (Decision.Self). What the click does (for example opening the decision) is not documented. It returns nothing.

label: Previous history page
summary: Turns the history in the Christian church window back one page.
details: Vanilla runs it from the back button. It returns nothing.

label: Window itself
summary: A function on the Christian church window that, going by its name, hands back the window itself.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type; Self after other types is only a hint.

label: Select future phase
summary: Going by its name, picks the given coming phase type in the Christian church window.
details: Vanilla never names it on this window. SituationWindow.SetSelectedFuturePhaseType is clicked with FutureSituationPhase.GetType.Self; that is only a hint. It returns nothing.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: The phase type to pick, going by the name.

label: Select group type
summary: Picks the given participant group type in the Christian church window.
details: Vanilla runs it when a group is clicked, passing that group's type. GetSelectedParticipantGroupType then returns it. It returns nothing.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: The participant group type to pick.
fields.values: a participant group type, such as SituationParticipantGroup.GetType.Self

label: Select sub-region
summary: Going by its name, picks the given sub-region in the Christian church window.
details: Vanilla never names it on this window; the Silk Road and situation windows' versions are clicked with SituationSubRegion.Self, only a hint. It returns nothing.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: The sub-region to pick, going by the name.

label: Toggle future phase
summary: Going by its name, picks the given coming phase type in the Christian church window, or unpicks it if it already is picked.
details: Vanilla never names it on this window; SituationWindow's version is clicked with FutureSituationPhase.GetType.Self, only a hint. It returns nothing.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: The phase type, going by the name.

label: Page phase book back
summary: Turns the Christian church window's phase book one page to the left.
details: Vanilla runs it from the left page button. It returns nothing.

label: Page phase book forward
summary: Turns the Christian church window's phase book one page to the right.
details: Vanilla runs it from the right page button. It returns nothing.

label: Participant list
summary: Going by its name, the list of participating characters in the Dynastic Cycle window.
details: The Dynastic Cycle window shows the Dynastic Cycle situation (eras, movements, the hegemon). Vanilla never names this on that window; the church window's version is only a hint.

label: Access window itself
summary: A function on the Dynastic Cycle window that, going by its name, hands back the window itself.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type; PdxGuiWidget.AccessSelf is a different type and only a hint.

label: Chaos era participants
summary: The list of participants shown in the Dynastic Cycle window during a chaos era.
details: Vanilla fills a list in the window from it. Going by the name, it is used in the chaos era. The game documents no return type.

label: Clear selected future era
summary: Going by its name, clears the coming era the player has picked in the Dynastic Cycle window.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type; the Dynastic Cycle window file calls SituationWindow.ClearSelectedFuturePhaseType when it opens and on a click, which is only a hint. It returns nothing.

label: Close window
summary: Going by its name, closes the Dynastic Cycle window.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type; the Dynastic Cycle window file closes through SituationWindow.Close instead. It returns nothing.

label: Catalysts of selected era
summary: Going by its name, the list of catalysts that apply to the era picked in the Dynastic Cycle window.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type; the situation window's own version is only a hint.

label: Current history page
summary: Going by its name, the entries on the history page now open in the Dynastic Cycle window.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type; the Dynastic Cycle window file reads SituationWindow.GetCurrentHistoryPage, and the church window has its own version. Both are hints only.

label: Cycle wheel texture
summary: The picture used for the wheel of eras in the Dynastic Cycle window.
details: Vanilla sets it as the texture of the wheel twice in the window. The game documents no return type.

label: Ending decisions
summary: Going by its name, the decisions that can end the Dynastic Cycle situation, as offered in this window.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type; StruggleWindow.GetEndingDecisions is only a hint.

label: Era position
summary: The position of the given era type on the Dynastic Cycle wheel, a whole number.
details: Vanilla passes the picked or current era and feeds the result into GetWheelRotateUV to turn the wheel to that era.

label: Era name
summary: The name of the given era type, as shown in the Dynastic Cycle window.
details: Vanilla passes each listed era (SituationPhaseType.Self).

fields.name: Arg0
fields.values: a situation phase type, such as SituationPhaseType.Self

label: Favored era
summary: The era that the given character favors, as shown in the Dynastic Cycle window.
details: Vanilla passes a character (Character.Self) and uses the result as context. The game documents no return type.

label: Hegemon or top candidate
summary: Going by its name, the hegemon of the Dynastic Cycle, or the top candidate for it when there is none.
details: Vanilla uses it as context for parts of the Dynastic Cycle window. This rests on the name and those uses; the game documents no return type.

label: Hegemony title
summary: Going by its name, the hegemony title of the Dynastic Cycle.
details: Vanilla's only use is in the favored era tooltip, which checks whether the title has a holder (GetHolder.IsValid) to pick a text. The rest of the line is cut short in the input. The game documents no return type.

label: History page count
summary: Going by its name, how many pages the history in the Dynastic Cycle window has.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type; the window file uses SituationWindow.GetHistoryPageCount, and the church window has its own version. Both are hints only.

label: History page number
summary: Going by its name, the number of the history page now open in the Dynastic Cycle window, counted from 1.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type; SituationWindow's and the church window's versions are hints only.

label: Share of land held
summary: How much of the land the given character holds, as a share shown in the Dynastic Cycle window.
details: Vanilla passes a character and shows the value next to a county control icon on independent rulers' portraits. What the share is measured against is not shown in the input.

label: Land held tooltip
summary: The tooltip about the land the given character holds, in the Dynastic Cycle window.
details: Vanilla passes a character (Character.Self).

label: Mandate candidates
summary: Going by its name, the list of characters who could take the mandate in the Dynastic Cycle.
details: Vanilla never uses it, so this rests on the name alone.

label: Mandate holder
summary: The holder of the mandate in the Dynastic Cycle window.
details: Vanilla uses it as context and reads GetCharacter from it, so it is an entry that leads to a character rather than the character itself. The game documents no return type.

label: Military strength
summary: The military strength of the given character, a whole number shown in the Dynastic Cycle window.
details: Vanilla shows it next to a soldier icon on independent rulers' portraits.

label: Military tooltip
summary: The tooltip about the given character's military strength in the Dynastic Cycle window.
details: Vanilla passes a character (Character.Self).

label: Movement power
summary: The movement power of the given participant group, a whole number.
details: In the Dynastic Cycle, participant groups are movements; vanilla shows this power in the group and movement tab texts and in the power tooltip.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.values: a situation participant group, such as SituationParticipantGroup.Self

label: Movement power breakdown
summary: Going by its name, the text explaining how the given group's movement power adds up.
details: Vanilla's only use is in the movement power tooltip, cut short in the input before this function shows.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: The participant group, going by the related GetMovementPowerValue.

label: Participation header
summary: Going by its name, the header text of the participation part of the Dynastic Cycle window.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type; SituationWindow's version is only a hint.

label: Era progress bar
summary: Going by its name, the progress bar of a sub-region's era in the Dynastic Cycle window.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type; other windows call their own version with SituationSubRegion.Self, only a hint.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: Going by other windows, the sub-region.

label: Selected future era
summary: The coming era picked in the Dynastic Cycle window.
details: Vanilla uses it as context of one part of the window. The game documents no return type.

label: Selected future era type
summary: The type of the coming era picked in the Dynastic Cycle window.
details: Vanilla checks whether it is valid (nothing may be picked) and uses it as context for the parts about that era.

label: Selected or current era
summary: Going by its name, the picked era type in the Dynastic Cycle window, or the current one when nothing is picked.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type; the window file reads SituationWindow.GetSelectedOrCurrentPhaseType instead, only a hint.

label: Selected or leading era
summary: Going by its name, the picked coming era type, or the one now in the lead when nothing is picked.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type; SituationWindow's version is only a hint.

label: Selected sub-region
summary: Going by its name, the sub-region picked in the Dynastic Cycle window.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type; SilkRoadWindow.GetSelectedSubRegion is only a hint.

label: Situation
summary: The situation the Dynastic Cycle window shows.
details: Vanilla reads its name for the "Eras of …" and "History of …" headings and lists its type's phases (the eras).

label: Situation decisions
summary: Going by its name, the decisions tied to the Dynastic Cycle situation, as listed in this window.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type; the window file reads SituationWindow.GetSituationDecisions, and the church window has its own version. Both are hints only.

label: Strongest movement
summary: Going by its name, the strongest participant group in the Dynastic Cycle.
details: Vanilla never uses it, so this rests on the name alone.

label: Top group participants
summary: The leading participants of the given participant group, as listed in the Dynastic Cycle window.
details: Vanilla passes the group (SituationParticipantGroup.Self) and fills a list from it. What makes a participant "top" is not documented.

label: Wheel rotation
summary: The rotation that turns the Dynastic Cycle wheel picture to a given era, a decimal number.
details: Vanilla sets the wheel's rotate_uv from it and passes the era's position (GetEraTypeIndex) as the first of three arguments; the other two are cut short in the input.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: The era's position on the wheel, as a fixed-point number.

label: Wheel rotation in radians
summary: Going by its name, the same wheel rotation as GetWheelRotateUV, given in radians.
details: Vanilla never uses it, so this rests on the name alone. It takes three arguments.

label: Has next history page
summary: Going by its name, whether the history in the Dynastic Cycle window has a page after the one now open.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type; the window file uses SituationWindow.HasNextHistoryPage, only a hint.

label: Has ending decision
summary: Going by its name, whether a decision that can end the Dynastic Cycle situation is available.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type; Struggle.HasPossibleEndingDecision is only a hint.

label: Has situation decision
summary: Going by its name, whether any decision tied to the Dynastic Cycle situation is available.
details: Vanilla never uses it, so this rests on the name alone.

label: Is era backward
summary: Whether moving from the first era to the second goes backward on the Dynastic Cycle wheel.
details: Vanilla passes the current phase's type and a coming phase's type and shows a marker when this holds.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.values: a phase type, such as SituationPhase.GetType

fields.name: Arg1
fields.values: a phase type, such as FutureSituationPhase.GetType

label: Is era forward
summary: Whether moving from the first era to the second goes forward on the Dynastic Cycle wheel.
details: Vanilla passes the current phase's type and a coming phase's type and shows a marker when this holds.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.values: a phase type, such as SituationPhase.GetType

fields.name: Arg1
fields.values: a phase type, such as FutureSituationPhase.GetType

label: Hegemon favors expansion
summary: Going by its name, whether the hegemon favors the expansion era.
details: Vanilla uses it in the Dynastic Cycle window to show a marker on eras other than one named in the line (cut short in the input).

label: Is chaos era
summary: Whether the Dynastic Cycle is in its chaos era right now.
details: Vanilla hides several parts of the window during the chaos era and shows others then.

label: Hegemon favors movement
summary: Whether the hegemon favors the given movement (participant group).
details: Vanilla passes each group (SituationParticipantGroup.Self) and shows a marker on the favored one.

label: Next era forward
summary: Whether the next era of the Dynastic Cycle lies forward on the wheel.
details: Vanilla shows one part when it holds and another when it does not.

label: Is participant
summary: Going by its name, whether someone takes part in the Dynastic Cycle; who is checked is not documented.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type. Activity.IsParticipant is a different type and only a hint.

label: Sorted by land
summary: Whether the Dynastic Cycle window's participant list is sorted by land held.
details: Vanilla switches parts of the list on and off with it, for example showing military strength only in that order and when it is above 0.

label: Sorted by power
summary: Going by its name, whether the Dynastic Cycle window's participant list is sorted by power.
details: Vanilla never uses it, so this rests on the name alone.

label: Hegemon favors era
summary: Whether the hegemon favors the given era.
details: Vanilla passes each listed era (SituationPhaseType.Self) and shows a marker on the favored one.

label: Next history page
summary: Going by its name, turns the Dynastic Cycle window's history to the next page.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type; the window file uses SituationWindow.NextHistoryPage. It returns nothing.

label: Click decision
summary: Going by its name, runs what happens when the player clicks a decision in the Dynastic Cycle window.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type; other windows' versions are clicked with Decision.Self, only a hint. It returns nothing.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: The clicked decision, going by other windows.

label: Previous history page
summary: Going by its name, turns the Dynastic Cycle window's history back one page.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type; the window file uses SituationWindow.PreviousHistoryPage. It returns nothing.

label: Window itself
summary: A function on the Dynastic Cycle window that, going by its name, hands back the window itself.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type; Self after other types is only a hint.

label: Select future era
summary: Going by its name, picks the given coming era type in the Dynastic Cycle window.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type; the window file clicks SituationWindow.SetSelectedFuturePhaseType with FutureSituationPhase.GetType.Self, only a hint. It returns nothing.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: The era type, going by the name.

label: Select sub-region
summary: Going by its name, picks the given sub-region in the Dynastic Cycle window.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type; other windows' versions are clicked with SituationSubRegion.Self, only a hint. It returns nothing.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: The sub-region, going by the name.

label: Toggle future era
summary: Going by its name, picks the given coming era type, or unpicks it if it already is picked.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type; SituationWindow's version is only a hint. It returns nothing.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: The era type, going by the name.

label: Select movement
summary: Makes the given participant group (movement) the one picked in the Dynastic Cycle window.
details: Vanilla picks the player's own group (Situation.GetTopCharacterParticipantGroup( GetPlayer.Self )) when the window opens, and a group when it is clicked. It returns nothing.

label: Access group itself
summary: A function on a group in the situation list that, going by its name, hands back the group itself.
details: A situation group item is one group of situations in the situation list window. Vanilla never names this on the type; PdxGuiWidget.AccessSelf is only a hint.

label: Group title
summary: The heading of a group in the situation list window.
details: Vanilla passes whether the 'your' tab is open, so the heading can differ between the player's own situations and all of them.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.values: yes or no, such as PdxGuiTabs.IsTabSet( 'your' )

label: Group type
summary: The type of a group in the situation list window.
details: Vanilla uses it as context of the group's part of the list. The game documents no return type.

label: Group items
summary: The situations listed under a group in the situation list window.
details: Vanilla fills the group's list from it and shows the group only when the list is not empty.

label: Involved item count
summary: How many of the group's situations count as involving, a whole number.
details: Vanilla passes whether the 'your' tab is open and shows the group only when this is above a number (cut short in the input). Going by the name, it counts the situations the player is involved in.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.values: yes or no, such as PdxGuiTabs.IsTabSet( 'your' )

label: Group itself
summary: A function on a group in the situation list that, going by its name, hands back the group itself.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type; Self after other types is only a hint.

label: Access type itself
summary: A function on a situation group type that, going by its name, hands back the type itself.
details: A situation group type is the kind of group situations are sorted under in the situation list. Vanilla never names this on the type; PdxGuiWidget.AccessSelf is only a hint.

label: Group type index
summary: Going by its name, the position number of a situation group type, a whole number.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type; GetIndex after other types (legitimacy types) is only a hint.

label: Group type key
summary: Going by its name, the script key of a situation group type.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type; GetKey after other types (buildings, house unity stages) gives their script key, which is a hint only.
